plugin.name: Vetta UI Design
plugin.description: Design UI mockups with Vetta on an infinite canvas: frames are real React code, select any element to have Vetta edit it, saves hot-reload instantly.
tab.label: Design
card.designSystems.title: Design systems
ds.title: Design systems
ds.subtitle: Pick a palette & spec and apply it to the whole design
ds.apply.restyle.sent: Handed to Vetta: restyling {{count}} frames as {{name}}
ds.confirm.restyle.title: Restyle the whole design as {{name}}?
ds.confirm.restyle.desc: Vetta will fully restyle all {{count}} frames to the new system. This takes a while. A backup is saved automatically — you can restore from here anytime.
ds.confirm.overwrite.title: Overwrite the existing design spec?
ds.confirm.overwrite.desc: This design already has a DESIGN.md. Applying {{name}} will replace it (a backup is saved; you can restore).
ds.confirm.restore.title: Restore to the pre-apply state?
ds.confirm.restore.desc: theme.css, DESIGN.md and all frame sources will return to how they were before the last apply. Changes made since will be lost.
ds.dialog.pickHint: Pick a template, then hit Apply
ds.tagline.notion: Warm-gray paper, text is the UI
ds.tagline.apple: Big type, big air, premium calm
ds.tagline.duolingo: Vivid green, buttons that press down
ds.tagline.figma: Tool white, blue select, purple spark
ds.tagline.openai: Lab white with a teal signal
